features.additionalInfo: You can choose anyone 18 years or older to receive a Corporate Card.
Through AutoPay you can choose to have the full closing balance directly debited from a nominated transaction account.

Complimentary transit accident insurance up to $250,000 for cardholders. Insurance certificates are available on the CommBank website. Search for 'Business credit cards' and refer to the 'Things you should know' section to view the relevant certificates.

Complimentary unauthorised transaction insurance up to $150,000 a year. Insurance certificates are available on the CommBank website. Search for 'Business credit cards' and refer to the 'Things you should know' section to view the relevant certificates.
Regardless of your business structure and needs, we have an online banking solution that will suit you.
Pay with your Apple(TM) device using Apple Pay.
Pay with your Android(TM) phone using the CommBank app.
Pay with your Fitbit(TM) smartwatch using Google SE.
Pay with your Garmin(TM) smartwatch using Garmin Pay.
Pay with your Android(TM) device using Google Pay(TM).
Pay with your Samsung(TM) device using Samsung Pay.
Use QR Cardless to withdraw cash or deposit notes, coins and cheques (subject to product eligibility) by using the latest version of the CommBank app to scan a QR code at a compatible CommBank ATM.
